title: Throat Circuit
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A vocal-ish growl bass that screams through cycling vowel formants over an FM core in the low-mid register. Over 32 cycles the FM index swells, the vowel sequence marches, and a crush/coarse degradation arc creeps in until the voice turns robotic and broken before resetting.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(3, 13)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/8")
    .vowel("<a e i o u a o e>/2")
    .penv("<0 0 7 -5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .vib("<5 7 11>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 1.8))
    .bpf(sine.slow(32).range(350, 2600)).resonance(16).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(3).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.14)
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 5))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4 1 2 4 8>/4")
    .shape(sine.slow(20).range(0.2, 0.55))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.06)
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.25).vowel("e"))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.3).gain(0.9)
)
